Why?
[/b]I made this for fun on my free time, because using Content Patcher for modding turned out to be so easy and I wanted to give it a try!
TL;DR: For the love of the game.

[b]Quick Q&A:[/b]
Q: Will I add other girls?
A: In this mod only Haley [s]and someone else[/s] are considered futanari. But if this weird-ahh mod will get some attention, I might consider making something bigger...
So, please, leave some comments or endorsments if you like this!

Q: Any compatability patches for other mods?

From 0.6 onward the mod is also i18n compatible![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Install SMAPI. 
Download Content Patcher and this mod.
Unpack them in Mods folder in your game directory.
Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI launcher.
You're amazing![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Only SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[b]
Compatability[/b]
Non compatible with any mods that change or affect base game Haley dialogues.
Compatible with anything else.[/size][/color]
